about_the_game:
Play as the Queen's Herald and immerse yourself in a text-based RPG full of choices and dice rolls. Interact with a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories to tell and secrets to uncover. Navigate a web of alliances and rivalries as you forge relationships with factions and people throughout The Mists.

The Queen’s army is gone, and The Mists hold the answers. Embark on an adventure through a mist-shrouded world and uncover the secrets hidden behind it. Dive into the depths of intrigue and betrayal as you navigate a realm where nothing is as it seems.

Shape your destiny through your choices and actions. Become a cunning rogue, a masterful mage, a fearless warrior, or something uniquely your own. You are travelling all the time, so what you decide to carry with yourself is equally important. Your decisions will carve your path.

  • Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy adventure filled with intrigue

  • Customize your Herald with a classless system driven by your inventory

  • Meet dozens of unique NPCs to befriend, fight or betray

  • Shape the narrative with meaningful choices and branching storylines

  • Unearth the truth behind the Queen’s missing army—no matter the cost

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: text-based violence.

short_description: A narrative-driven RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Step into the role of the Queen's Herald and traverse a mist-shrouded realm to uncover the fate of her lost army. Will your choices uphold loyalty, or lead you down a path of betrayal? The secrets of the mists await.
